name: College Board Bluebook™
description: The official Digital SAT testing application. Contains 6 free full-length adaptive Digital SAT practice tests with exact test-day timing, calculator, and interface.
bestFor: Taking realistic diagnostic tests and getting familiar with the exact Digital SAT interface.

name: Khan Academy Official Digital SAT Prep
description: Official partner of College Board offering thousands of interactive practice questions, video lessons, diagnostic quizzes, and personalized skill tracks.
bestFor: Building conceptual foundations in Math and Reading/Writing step by step.

name: College Board Educator Question Bank
description: Official repository containing thousands of real Digital SAT questions filterable by domain, skill, and difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard).
bestFor: Targeted drill practice for specific weak topics using authentic College Board items.

name: College Board SAT Registration Portal
description: The only authorized portal to register for official SAT test administrations, locate test centers worldwide, and download admission tickets.
bestFor: Registering for upcoming SAT test dates and checking test center seat availability.

name: College Board Score Reporting & Sending
description: Official score report delivery system to view total, section, and subscores, superscore, and send official score reports to universities.
bestFor: Accessing official score reports and sending 4 free score sends before the deadline.

name: Official Desmos SAT Graphing Calculator
description: The exact version of the Desmos graphing calculator embedded directly inside the Bluebook testing application. Practice regressions, system solvers, and slider tricks.
bestFor: Mastering Desmos tricks to solve hard algebra, quadratic, and geometry problems in under 30 seconds.

name: The Critical Reader by Erica Meltzer
description: Renowned Digital SAT Reading and Grammar preparation textbooks. Deeply breaks down rhetorical synthesis, transitions, boundaries, and punctuation rules.
bestFor: Students scoring 600-750 looking to eliminate grammar and inference errors to reach 780-800.

name: The College Panda SAT Math
description: Comprehensive textbook covering all Advanced Math, circle geometry, and tricky algebra concepts with rigorous drills and clear formula explanations.
bestFor: Mastering high-difficulty math questions and eliminating careless formula mistakes.

name: 1600.io SAT Math Orange Books & Video Tools
description: Extremely thorough conceptual breakdown of every single SAT math topic, with an emphasis on mathematical intuition rather than just rote memorization.
bestFor: Complete step-by-step re-learning of math fundamentals up to 800-level questions.

name: UWorld Digital SAT Prep
description: High-quality question bank with in-depth visual answer explanations, performance tracking, and difficulty rankings matching the actual Digital SAT.
bestFor: Rigorous timed practice drills with exceptional answer explanations.

name: r/Sat Community (Reddit)
description: Active global community of over 400,000 students, tutors, and 1600 scorers sharing tips, advice, resource recommendations, and test-day experiences.
bestFor: Discussing difficult questions, staying updated on testing center news, and peer advice.

name: PrepPros Complete Digital SAT Guides
description: Popular YouTube channel and course series focusing on Desmos graphing calculator shortcuts, module 2 hard question strategies, and timing management.
bestFor: Learning time-saving Desmos tricks and pacing strategies for the second adaptive module.

name: College Board International Testing Policies
description: Official rules for international test takers: acceptable forms of ID (valid passport), international fee schedules, regional fee assistance, and center policies.
bestFor: Reviewing mandatory passport and ID requirements for students testing outside the US.

name: College Board Device Lending Program
description: Information on borrowing an approved device from College Board if you do not have access to a laptop or tablet for the Digital SAT.
bestFor: Students requiring a borrowed device; must be requested at least 30 days before test date.
